text: What does (int) (-9.75) give in Java?
why: A cast to int cuts off the fraction, towards zero, so (int) (-9.75) is -9. Math.floor(-9.75) would give -10. The other options come from common slips: -10 if you rounded down, as Math.floor does; -9.75 if you kept the fraction; 9 if you dropped the minus sign.
